resources.string: Reads TikTok LIVE rooms and product cards only after you enable it. Product recognition uses your authorized system text model to identify clothing from product titles. The explicit Try on action captures one LIVE snapshot and uses your authorized system image model to find one clear top actually worn by the presenter. Its original pixels become the try-on reference. This action opens your front-camera window and sends the reference and your camera video to cloud AI, billed by usage for up to 60 seconds. Close the window to stop. Unclear or ambiguous clothing, a changed room, missing AI access or a failed capture stops this attempt. It does not open product pages, buy products or add them to the cart. The separate automatic image-recognition option may send one LIVE screenshot to system AI before a reminder, only when you enable it. Model usage may incur charges. You can turn observation off at any time.
